'''Cerosi Town''' (Japanese: '''セルロスタウン''' ''Cellulos Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive town located on [[Izabe Island]] in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]]. It was never seen onscreen, but it was mentioned in ''[[AG103|A Cacturne for the Worse]]'', ''[[AG106|Beg, Burrow and Steal]]'', ''[[AG108|Let it Snow, Let it Snow, Let it Snorunt!]]'', and ''[[AG109|Do I Hear a Ralts?]]''. {{Ash}}, {{an|Brock}}, {{an|May}}, and [[Max]] were traveling to Cerosi Town because it has ferry services to [[Sootopolis City]].
